faqPreview.a: If you are unsure—Snapshot. If you need one domain—Focus. For 2-3 coordinated domains—Context. For full cross-domain synthesis—Strategy workspace. No site—Discovery.
Snapshot gives first visibility from public signals. Workspace adds your context, coordinates domain analysis, and builds roadmap.
Yes. The workspace output and roadmap are written so your team or another vendor can run with them.

whatWeDoLines: Capture business context and public signals: site, UX, trust, baseline technical visibility.
Diagnose processes: manual repeats, gaps between tools, communication friction.
Prioritize improvements and automation with impact / effort sizing.
Roadmap: what to do now, what to defer, what to delegate—with clear next steps.
chooseEntryDescription: Same context-first flow—different depth and speed. Pick the path that matches your readiness and horizon.
coveragePackagesDescription: Choose depth: one domain, a coordinated multi-domain pack, or full synthesis and roadmap.

snapshot.description: A quick read on public signals—see where to focus first without a heavy commitment.

discovery.description: Shape structure and the next step when the site or scope is still fuzzy.

brief.description: Share context—we suggest a sensible route (Snapshot, Focus, Context, or Strategy workspace).
